info.name: Presentation Converter
info.summary: Automatically generate PDF versions of every presentation in a folder and its subfolders, with a presenter-notes sidecar
info.description:
Keeps PDF copies of your presentations up to date automatically.
Point the app at one or more folders and it will convert every Keynote, PowerPoint, ODP and legacy .ppt presentation found in them - and in all their subfolders - to PDF, writing the PDF alongside the original (or into a folder of your choosing). Alongside each PDF it writes a `.notes.json` sidecar containing the presenter notes, slide titles and the slide-to-page mapping, so the notes survive a conversion that would otherwise throw them away.
Conversion happens server-side through LibreOffice. Because Keynote cannot run on a Linux server, `.key` files can optionally be forwarded to a paired macOS machine running `presentation-converter serve` - see the admin settings.
Files are only ever converted when the source is newer than the existing PDF, so a scan over an unchanged folder is cheap.
info.author: Allan Sargeant
